verdict.rationale: AMD's GAIA framework explicitly states that local inference on Ryzen AI hardware 'keeps your data private' and 'avoids cloud usage,' which implicitly prevents user data from reaching cloud training pipelines. However, this is an indirect architectural benefit (local-only compute) rather than an explicit privacy control, opt-out mechanism, or data-use policy addressing AI training. Missing for 10: explicit data-training opt-out settings, a formal privacy policy statement on AI training use, and independent verification that no telemetry/data is collected from Ryzen AI software.
